perfil: Firenze can summon doppelgangers to fight for her on the battlefield. Rumor has it that she does the same in her office, which is how she always manages to stay so graceful.

habilidades.b: Swings the cane to strike multiple times and summons ⟨Shadow Clone⟩ to attack.

tpl.s: Swings the cane to strike multiple times. Strike 1: ⟦0⟧ of ATK as Umbra Auto Attack DMG. Strike 2: ⟦1⟧ of ATK as Umbra Auto Attack DMG. Strike 3: ⟦2⟧ of ATK as Umbra Auto Attack DMG. Strike 4: ⟦3⟧ and ⟦4⟧ of ATK as Umbra Auto Attack DMG. When there is no ⟨Shadow Clone⟩ present, the 2nd hit of the Auto Attack summons 1 ⟨Shadow Clone⟩. The 4th hit of the Auto Attack commands all ⟨Shadow Clone⟩ to sprint strike, dealing ⟦5⟧ of ATK as Umbra Minion DMG.

habilidades.b: Unleashes combo slashes with the cane sword, dealing multiple instances of DMG. Casting the Main Skill can summon ⟨Shadow Clone⟩ and trigger combo slashes. The Main Skill and ⟨Shadow Clone⟩ can trigger ⟨Umbra Mark⟩.

tpl.s: Unleashes combo slashes with the cane sword, dealing ⟦0⟧ of ATK as Umbra Skill DMG. When casting the Main Skill, summons 1 ⟨Shadow Clone⟩ and orders all ⟨Shadow Clone⟩ to unleash combo slashes, dealing ⟦1⟧ of ATK as Umbra Minion DMG. It can be cast 2 times initially. Elegant Parade (Main Skill) and ⟨Shadow Clone⟩ can trigger ⟨Umbra Mark⟩, dealing ⟪0⟫ of ATK as Umbra Mark DMG and inflicting ⟨Dark Burn⟩.

habilidades.b: Pounds the ground to deal AoE DMG and summons multiple ⟨Shadow Clone⟩. When the main Trekker deals DMG, ⟨Shadow Clone⟩ also strike at the target. The Support Skill and ⟨Shadow Clone⟩ can trigger ⟨Umbra Mark⟩.

tpl.s: Strikes the ground with the cane, dealing ⟦0⟧ of ATK as AoE Umbra Skill DMG, and summons 2 ⟨Shadow Clone⟩. When the main Trekker deals DMG, ⟨Shadow Clone⟩ also strike at the target, dealing ⟦1⟧ of ATK as Umbra Minion DMG. This effect can only be triggered once every 1.5s. Reign of Night (Support Skill) and ⟨Shadow Clone⟩ can trigger ⟨Umbra Mark⟩, dealing ⟪0⟫ of ATK as Umbra Mark DMG and inflicting ⟨Dark Burn⟩.

habilidades.b: Spreads a dark magic circle, dealing multiple instances of DMG. The Ultimate can trigger ⟨Umbra Mark⟩.

tpl.s: Spreads a dark magic circle, dealing ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧ of ATK as Umbra Ultimate DMG. Darkness Descends (Ultimate) can trigger ⟨Umbra Mark⟩, dealing ⟪0⟫ of ATK as Umbra Mark DMG and inflicting ⟨Dark Burn⟩.

builds.d: A build that enhances combat mobility and skill activation frequency.
A summoner build that enhances clone capabilities and attack synergy.

l.b: The Main Skill deals additional damage.
l.s: When casting Elegant Parade (Main Skill), Firenze deals an additional ⟦0⟧ of ATK as AoE Umbra Skill DMG.

l.b: When Firenze's Main Skill deals DMG for a certain number of times, she creates a domain that deals continuous AoE DMG and boosts her Skill DMG.
l.s: After Firenze's Elegant Parade (Main Skill) deals DMG ⟦0⟧ times, it creates a domain for 7s, dealing ⟦1⟧ of ATK as AoE Umbra Skill DMG every 0.5s and increases Firenze's Skill DMG by ⟦2⟧. The domain's DMG can trigger ⟨Umbra Mark⟩.

l.b: When Firenze deals Skill DMG, there is a chance to deal additional DMG.
l.s: When Firenze deals Skill DMG, there is a 40% chance to deal an additional ⟦0⟧ of ATK as Umbra Skill DMG. The chance is increased to 80% if the target is inflicted with ⟨Dark Burn⟩. This effect can only be triggered 2 times every second.

l.b: When Firenze triggers an ⟨Umbra Mark⟩, increases ATK.
l.s: When Firenze triggers an ⟨Umbra Mark⟩, increases ATK by ⟦0⟧ for 3s.

l.b: When Firenze deals DMG with an Auto Attack, increases her Skill DMG. The effect ends if the Main Skill is cast.
l.s: When Firenze deals DMG with an Auto Attack, increases her Skill DMG by ⟦0⟧ for 5s, stacking up to ⟦1⟧ times. The effect ends if Elegant Parade (Main Skill) is cast.

l.b: Firenze automatically summons ⟨Shadow Clone⟩. When casting the Main Skill, increases the number of ⟨Shadow Clone⟩ summoned.
l.s: Firenze generates ⟦0⟧ ⟨Shadow Clone⟩ every ⟦1⟧s. When casting Elegant Parade (Main Skill), increases the number of ⟨Shadow Clone⟩ summoned by ⟦2⟧.

l.b: Upon vanishing, Firenze's ⟨Shadow Clone⟩ will explode, dealing AoE DMG. The max limit of ⟨Shadow Clone⟩ increases for every other Umbra Trekker in the squad.
l.s: Upon vanishing, Firenze's ⟨Shadow Clone⟩ will explode, dealing ⟦0⟧ of ATK as AoE Umbra Minion DMG. The max limit of ⟨Shadow Clone⟩ increases by ⟦1⟧ for every other Umbra Trekker in the squad.

l.b: ⟨Shadow Clone⟩ lasts longer on the battlefield. Also increases Minion DMG.
l.s: ⟨Shadow Clone⟩ lasts ⟦0⟧s longer on the battlefield. Also increases Minion DMG by ⟦1⟧.

l.b: After Firenze casts the Main Skill, her next Auto Attack starts with the 4th strike. Also increases ⟨Shadow Clone⟩'s Minion DMG.
l.s: After Firenze casts Elegant Parade (Main Skill), her next Auto Attack directly casts the last strike. Also increases ⟨Shadow Clone⟩'s Minion DMG by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: Increases ⟨Shadow Clone⟩'s max limit and Umbra DMG.
l.s: Increases ⟨Shadow Clone⟩'s max limit by 1 and Umbra DMG by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: Each Umbra Trekker in the squad increases Firenze's Umbra DMG.
l.s: For each Umbra Trekker in the squad, increases Firenze's Umbra DMG by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: Firenze can dodge one more time. Increases her ATK when dodging.
l.s: Firenze can dodge one more time. When dodging, increases Firenze's ATK by ⟦0⟧ for 6s.

l.b: Firenze can dodge through barriers. Increases ⟨Shadow Clone⟩'s DMG.
l.s: Firenze can dodge through barriers. Increases ⟨Shadow Clone⟩'s Minion DMG by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: When Firenze casts her Ultimate, each ⟨Shadow Clone⟩ on the battlefield increases her Ultimate DMG.
l.s: Firenze absorbs all ⟨Shadow Clone⟩ when casting Personal Tuition (Ultimate). Each ⟨Shadow Clone⟩ absorbed increases Ultimate DMG by ⟦0⟧, up to 5 stacks.

l.b: When Firenze deals DMG, increases Ultimate Crit Rate.
l.s: When Firenze deals DMG, increases Ultimate Crit Rate by ⟦0⟧ for 5s.

l.b: When Firenze triggers an ⟨Umbra Mark⟩, increases Ultimate DMG.
l.s: When Firenze triggers an ⟨Umbra Mark⟩, increases Ultimate DMG by ⟦0⟧ for 20s, up to 10 stacks. The effect ends if Personal Tuition (Ultimate) is cast.
